user.title: Connect to the Imou Open Platform
user.description: Enter the App ID and App Secret of your Imou Open Platform developer app. The README explains how to create one.

data_description.app_id: Shown under App Information in your Imou Open Platform Control Board.
data_description.app_secret: Shown next to the App ID. It is stored in Home Assistant and never logged.
data_description.region: The data centre of your Imou account.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Imou
reauth_confirm.description: Imou rejected the stored credentials. Enter the current App Secret of your Imou Open Platform app.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Imou cloud. Check your internet connection and the selected region.
error.invalid_auth: Imou rejected the App ID or App Secret.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This App ID is already configured.

init.title: Choose a robot
init.description: Choose the robot whose rooms you want to name.

rooms.title: Room names of {robot}
rooms.description: The robot does not report its rooms. The rooms below come from the cleaning schedules in the Imou app. Write one room per line as `id = name`. These names are used for room cleaning and in the schedules sensor.

data_description.room_names: One room per line, for example `3 = Blue room`. The id is the room number from the schedules.

error.invalid_room_names: Every line must look like `3 = Blue room`: a room number, an equals sign and a name.

abort.no_rooms: No rooms are known yet. The robot only reveals its rooms in the cleaning schedules. Create a schedule in the Imou app that selects the rooms (you may switch it off afterwards), then try again.

auth_failed.message: Imou rejected the App ID or App Secret.

cannot_connect.message: Could not reach the Imou cloud: {error}

no_robots_found.message: No Imou robot vacuum was found on this account. Add the robot under Device Access Service in the Imou Open Platform Control Board, then reload this integration.

update_failed.message: Could not read the robot's state: {error}

command_failed.message: The Imou cloud did not accept the command: {error}

invalid_fan_speed.message: {fan_speed} is not a valid fan speed for this robot. Use one of the levels the robot offers, for example standard.

invalid_option.message: {option} is not a valid choice for this robot.

unknown_command.message: Unknown command {command}. Use a service of the robot's things model, for example clean_control.

invalid_command_params.message: Invalid parameters for {command}: {params}. Use a dictionary of the service's input identifiers.

invalid_room.message: {room} is not a valid room id. Use the room number from the schedules, for example 3.
